event: GPU driver stall during the repaired paired retention pilot
state: snapshot preserved; execution canceled; continuation pending
gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

active_cell.observed_duration_note: Journal age is not measured attempt execution time. The recorded attempt elapsed_seconds=0.0 is an initialization placeholder preserved on resume, not a measured zero. No finalized trajectory or memory metrics were available for this cell.

observations: The experiment runner was in uninterruptible kernel wait (D state), with wait channel uvm_gpu_release and no log or CPU-time progress.
A single bounded nvidia-smi diagnostic produced no output; its Slurm step failed to terminate cleanly.
Slurm drained the node with a Kill task failed reason for that diagnostic step.
The experiment step was canceled and the run flock was released. Kernel-side cleanup on the drained node was not confirmed complete.
No GPU reset or node configuration change was attempted.
The root cause is unresolved; the evidence does not distinguish a device fault from a driver/runtime interaction.

continuation_policy.hardware_requirement: Another node with the same GPU class and compatible runtime; health guard before resume.
continuation_policy.interrupted_cell: Keep as a failure and reserve its remaining 600-second budget; do not grant a replacement attempt.
continuation_policy.missing_metrics: Keep missing memory absent and measured attempt duration unavailable; the raw duration field remains a journal placeholder. Do not report either as measured zero.
continuation_policy.scoring: Only after all 32 cells are terminal; retain the interruption in the denominator.
continuation_policy.interpretation: Infrastructure interruption and changed host confound the pilot; uncertainty intervals do not remove these limitations.

artifact_note: Portable evidence filenames and hashes identify the preserved ignored bundle; no private account or storage references are published.

pending_continuation.estimate_note: Subject to scheduler changes; pending jobs consume no GPU allocation.
pending_continuation.availability: Only two nodes expose the compatible GPU class; the original node is drained and the other is unavailable.
pending_continuation.guard: Require released run lock, unchanged hashes of all 460 terminal artifacts, original source/config/packages, identical GPU name/capacity/driver/CUDA runtime, and a successful tiny BF16 CUDA operation before resume.
pending_continuation.remaining_work: Queued: six untouched cells, offline scoring/analysis, separate numerical compaction/position checks, and CPU export. After jobs finish: local artifact verification, trace summary, reviewed report/graph and results commit.

dependent_cpu_export.behavior: Exports experiment artifacts after successful execution/scoring and preserves postflight success or failure evidence.
